digest.component_or_area: plan review criterion gating (T13, T14, removal-rationale, asserted-capability)
propositions: Four zero-finding criteria (T13, T14, removal-rationale, asserted-capability) generated ~7,900 wasted agentic runs with zero findings despite covering applicable plans.
Deterministic pre-filter gates must fire only when criterion subject vocabulary is present in plan text or file_impact metadata, delegating applicability judgment to the unchanged LLM router.

T13 and T14 overlay criteria extend _DET_OVERLAY_RULES with multi-element text_all regex conjunctions and optional file_impact glob/reason arms; removal-rationale and asserted-capability leaf criteria use parallel _DET_LEAF_GATE_RULES table gated at route_criteria after the is_overlay guard.
Every skipped criterion must be recorded in coverage.routing.det_gated keyed by criterion id with the not-fired rule name, visible in the REVIEW_RESULT sidecar.

Asserted-capability fires only when both legs match (module-ref pattern AND capability-verb pattern as a conjunction); removal-rationale fires on plan text OR file_impact reason matching removal-vocabulary regex.
